judgements.label: physical-error
judgements.violated_check: check1 (modification value divergence on same target)
judgements.applied_rule: N1 ruling explicitly binning bi=1229 pollution-default (send to refute); frozen case 3 mirror rejects insensitivity exemption
judgements.rationale: Query: 'reduce that unit to a lower dispatch level' (no value pinned). Reference sets gen 0 p_mw=262.9; model halves it to 159.0 (check1: gen.p_mw 159.0 vs 262.9, same target gen 0). The GT scenario was therefore not executed; the scalar matches to 1e-15 (0.90019489935878) only because the min-voltage envelope is dispatch-insensitive here (PV-bus setpoints pin vm) -- exactly the 'insensitive therefore exempt' pattern case 3 forbids. Loop mechanics are otherwise N2-conformant (all 4 lines enumerated, 4/4 converged, min-of-min == envelope min, deepcopy per case). Refute-pass note: 159 MW fully satisfies the query text (lower than base 318), so this is a strong equivalence/item-underdetermination refute candidate, but under the frozen N1 default it is pollution.
